title: AI Test Prompting: natural language to a test, replay without AI
description:
AI Test Prompting: use natural language to generate a test, save it, and replay it without AI. Here, "Go to live TV, zap 3 times and check the picture moves after each zap" becomes a test on a real set-top box: three zaps, a motion check after each. It passes, you save it, and every run after that replays the saved steps with no AI call.

Open source and free.
